name: Aim Angle
summary: A Smart Action that sets the direction the reticle moves. Used with Aim Magnitude, which sets the speed.

where.text: Edit your Config (pencil icon) and open a binding, or add one with the + button at the end of the bindings list. Select the Smart Actions Editor button at the bottom, then add Aim Angle from the Aim Control category.

citations.quote: To edit the current Config, press the pencil icon.
To change a binding, just click on it.
To add a binding, press the '+' button at the end of the bindings list.
Select the Smart Actions Editor button at the bottom
Available actions you can use in your sequence.
Smart Actions come in categories of functionality.
Actions used to augment reticle velocity that seamlessly combines with the gamer's aim.

definition.text: Moves the reticle at a set angle and blends with your own aim. Used for things like recoil control or auto-turn, together with Aim Magnitude.

citations.quote: Move reticle at specified angle. Seamlessly integrates with user aim. Use in scenarios such as recoil control or auto-turn. (Use with Aim Magnitude.)

definition.caveat: In Destiny 2, Bungie's account policy says using keyboard/mouse adapters to "reduce recoil" "would be a violation", which can lead to escalating actions, including bans. See the Destiny 2 note on Bungie's policy.

plainWords.text: Aim Control actions add to your own aim rather than replacing it.

citations.quote: Actions used to augment reticle velocity that seamlessly combines with the gamer's aim. Used in a variety of scenarios including recoil control.

plainWords.text: For the reticle, use Aim Angle rather than Right Stick Angle, which doesn't blend with aim.

citations.quote: This action does not integrate with aim. Use Aim Angle for reticle modification.

confusions.name: Angle Quantization
confusions.note: Snaps the direction your reticle moves to set angles. An aim setting, not an action.

confusions.name: Aim Angle Variance
confusions.note: Offsets this action's angle slightly above or below the value you set.

statement.text: A Smart Action that sets the right stick's angle directly, for example for radial menus. It doesn't blend with your aim.

citations.quote: Set right thumbstick angle at specified value. Use in scenarios such as automatic radial menu selection. (Use with Right Stick Magnitude.)
This action does not integrate with aim. Use Aim Angle for reticle modification.
